summary: Declarative decomposition of the smart textile requirements from CAID Form issue 283; design and physical verification are separate.

root.name: Thermal management wearable
root.purpose: Sense temperature, accept user requests and manage textile-mounted cooling.

children.name: Electrical system
children.purpose: Supply and interconnect the wearable modules.

children.name: Energy and charging
children.purpose: Qi receiver, thin-film battery, regulated logic and TEC supply.
constraints: Battery, charger and conversion ratings unknown

children.name: Controller
children.purpose: Nordic nRF52840 BLE control and local physical input.

children.name: Temperature sensing
children.purpose: Skin and ambient I2C sensor channels; calibration and package parts unresolved.

children.name: TEC power drive
children.purpose: Two actuator channels sharing the specified 1 A peak budget.

children.name: Textile and thermal assembly
children.purpose: Integrate flexible PCB, textile, thermal elements and body interfaces.

children.name: Layered garment
children.purpose: Define textile and flex laminate layers, attachments and contact.

children.name: Thermal path
children.purpose: Peltier cold/hot surfaces, PCM storage and ambient heat rejection.
constraints: TEC curves, PCM parameters and conductance unknown

children.name: Wearer interface
children.purpose: Torso attachment and hand access to local physical controls.

children.name: Behavior and interaction
children.purpose: Accept local/BLE requests and eventually regulate thermal feedback.

children.name: Local interaction
children.purpose: Executed contact and debounce toggle a virtual cooling request.

children.name: BLE interface
children.purpose: Required remote interface; firmware and radio not executed.

children.name: Thermal regulation
children.purpose: Required closed-loop regulation; no validated plant or sensor model yet.
